section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM - Cruise Control System
title: Stop Light Switch and Actuator

content.description: Stop light switch connector diagrams showing 2-pin and 4-pin configurations. Left connector shows terminals 1 and 2, right connector shows terminals 1, 2, 3, and 4

content.text: If continuity is not as specified, replace the switch.

items.title: INSPECT CONTROL CABLE FREEPLAY
items.text:
Inspect that the control cable freeplay is less than 10 mm (0.39 in.).
If necessary, adjust the control cable freeplay.

content.description: Illustration showing hand inspecting actuator control cable freeplay by pulling cable

items.title: INSPECT ACTUATOR RESISTANCE
items.text: Using an ohmmeter, measure the resistance value between terminals as follows.

content.description: Circular diagram showing actuator connector terminal layout with terminals 1, 2, and 3 arranged around the connector face

content.text: If the resistance value is not as specified, replace the actuator.

items.title: INSPECT ACTUATOR OPERATION
items.text:
Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminals 2 and 3. Connect the negative (−) lead to terminal 1.
(a) Slowly apply vacuum from 0—300 mmHg (0—11.81 in.Hg, 0 — 40.0 kPa), and check that the control cable can be pulled smoothly.
(b) With the vacuum stabilized, check that the control cable does not return.
(c) Disconnect terminal 2 or 3 and check that the control cable returns to its original position and the vacuum returns to 0 mmHg (0 in.Hg, 0 kPa).
If operation is not as specified, replace the actuator.

content.description: Illustration showing vacuum gauge connected to actuator with battery connections for testing actuator operation
Similar illustration to previous showing vacuum gauge connected to actuator for testing return operation
